title: Oxva Origin X Replacement Pod 2 pack
description: The Origin X pod kit from Oxva is a sleek and versatile pod kit that uses Oxva’s UNI coils for incredible flavour and reliable performance. The Origin X pods utilise Oxva’s excellent UNI coils for amazing flavour and an external 18650 battery provides reliable power and longevity. Comfortable to use and highly portable, the Origin X by Oxva is a discreet yet powerful pod kit ideal for vapers of all levels. The Origin X 2ml pods attach firmly to the mod with strong magnets, and changing coils is a breeze thanks to a push to fit system. Refilling is simple and mess-free too with a bottom-fill system sealed by a silicone stopper. The Origin X pods utilise Oxva’s excellent UNI coils for amazing flavour and longevity. Please note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
